questions.question: What did Pam say creates a good bond between a dog and its owner?
questions.explanation: 帕姆强调好关系来自良好的沟通。

questions.question: Why did Nero try to use the tunnel and other equipment?
options: He wanted to look impressive to Dev
He needed to escape a storm
He was looking for Duke's collar
questions.explanation: 尼禄想让德夫发现自己也很厉害，擅自尝试训练器材。

questions.question: What happened when Nero tried jumping through the hoop?
options: The hoop fell over and frightened him
questions.explanation: 尼禄尝试钻圈时圆环倒下，响声吓到了他。

questions.question: How did Duke help Nero off the seesaw?
options: He pulled Nero by his collar
He pushed the seesaw so Nero slid down
questions.explanation: 杜克推动跷跷板，尼禄才滑了下来。

questions.question: Why did Nero run away after the lesson?
options: He felt upset when Pam said he and Dev communicated poorly
questions.explanation: 帕姆评价他们沟通差、关系不够好，让尼禄伤心逃跑。

questions.question: Who did Pam send to find Nero in the woods?
questions.explanation: 帕姆叫杜克进树林寻找尼禄。

questions.question: What did Nero discover about Duke after Duke followed him into the mud?
questions.explanation: 尼禄终于明白杜克只是想和他做朋友。

questions.question: How did Duke get hurt?
options: He slipped into a muddy ditch and became trapped under a log
He was hit by a bicycle
He was scratched by a cat
questions.explanation: 杜克滑进泥沟并钻到木头下面，伤到了腿。

questions.question: Why didn't Nero explain Duke's injury aloud to Dev?
options: He had forgotten how to talk
Pam was there, so he could not reveal that he talks
He wanted to keep Duke hidden
questions.explanation: 帕姆就在德夫旁边，尼禄不能暴露自己会说话。

questions.question: What did Nero try to make Dev do?
options: Follow him back to injured Duke
questions.explanation: 他拉着德夫想带他去受伤的杜克那里。

questions.question: How did Nero communicate Duke's injury without speaking?
options: He acted it out with charades
questions.explanation: 尼禄模仿杜克摔倒并跛行，让德夫猜出情况。

questions.question: What did Pam and Dev have to lift in the muddy ditch?
questions.explanation: 两人合力抬起压住杜克的大木头。

questions.question: Why couldn't Pam simply carry Duke out immediately?
options: He refused to wear a leash
She was afraid of muddy water
She had to hold up the heavy log
questions.explanation: 帕姆要扶住木头，没法同时把受伤的杜克抱走。

questions.question: How did Nero pull Duke to safety?
options: He pushed him with a skateboard
He grabbed Duke's collar with his teeth
questions.explanation: 尼禄听从德夫指令，用牙咬住项圈拉出杜克。

questions.question: What did Pam write in Nero's graduation note?
options: Nero and Dev have great communication
Nero still needs to learn to sit
Duke should join a new school
Dev must buy Nero new toys
questions.explanation: 帕姆认可两人沟通默契，尼禄顺利毕业。

questions.question: Where was Dev planning to go for Take Your Kid to Work Day?
questions.explanation: 德夫要和爸爸一起参观他工作的麦片工厂。

questions.question: Why did Dad say Nero could not come along?
options: Dogs were not allowed near the food
questions.explanation: 爸爸说狗不能出现在食品附近，因此不准尼禄同行。

questions.question: How did Nero secretly join the factory visit?
options: He climbed through a factory window
questions.explanation: 尼禄偷偷钻进德夫的背包，藏在午餐下面。

questions.question: What did Dev think made his backpack unusually heavy?
options: An extra-large lunch packed by Dad
questions.explanation: 德夫不知道背包里藏着尼禄，以为爸爸装了很大的午餐。

questions.question: What alarmed Nero as they reached the factory?
options: Familiar sounds and smells reminded him of Dr. Shady's lab
questions.explanation: 熟悉的声音和气味让尼禄怀疑又回到莎迪博士的实验室。

questions.question: Why did Nero believe a secret lab was near the cereal factory?
options: He recognized the place from his time with Dr. Shady
He had found a written invitation
The mayor told him about it
Dev found a map in the cereal
questions.explanation: 尼禄认出这里，坚信莎迪博士的实验室就在附近。

questions.question: Where did Dev put Nero so they could move around the factory?
questions.explanation: 德夫把尼禄塞进推车，推着他在工厂里走动。

questions.question: What did Nero's nose lead them to first?
questions.explanation: 尼禄循着香味来到一大缸麦片前，并没有找到实验室。

questions.question: What happened when Dev pressed the button near the big fan?
options: The fan blew them across the floor
questions.explanation: 德夫按按钮后风扇改变方向，把两人吹得滑过地面。

questions.question: Who caught Nero after he made cereal fly everywhere?
questions.explanation: 尼禄从传送带滑下弄得到处是麦片，最后爸爸出现。
